# glinet_tethering_status (Data Source)

Get the state of the USB tethering uplink of the router: a phone on USB (`tethering.get_status`). The read was tested on a router only without a phone on USB. The values with a phone come from the web UI code. The values change while the router runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_tethering_status" "usb" {}

output "tethering_connected" {
  value = data.glinet_tethering_status.usb.status == "connected"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) Phones on USB (`devices`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `ipv4` (Attributes) IPv4 address of the uplink (`ipv4`). This value comes from the web UI code and was not seen on a router. Null when the router gives no IPv4 address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))
- `status` (String) Status of the uplink: `not_connected` (`0`), `connected` (`1`) or `connecting` (`2`). A router without a phone on USB gave `connecting`. Null when the router gives a code that is not in this list.
- `status_code` (Number) Status of the uplink as a number (`status`).

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `device` (String) Name of the network device of the phone (`device`).
- `type` (String) Type of the phone (`type`): `android` (`0`) or `ios` (`1`). Null when the router gives no type or a code that is not in this list.
- `use` (Boolean) Whether the uplink uses this phone (`use`).


<a id="nestedatt--ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4`

Read-Only:

- `dns` (List of String) DNS servers (`dns`).
- `gateway` (String) IPv4 gateway (`gateway`). Null when the router gives no gateway.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address with the prefix length (`ip`), for example `192.0.2.10/24`. Null when the router gives no address.
